name: composer
title: Composer
description: An animated chat composer for React and shadcn, with file attachments and a Stop button while a reply streams.

meta.details: A chat composer that grows on a spring, opens an attachments row with Auto Height, and morphs its Send arrow into a Stop square while a reply streams. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, Escape stops; files can be picked, dropped or pasted. Wires straight into AI SDK useChat.

docs: Import Composer from components/eased/composer/composer. With AI SDK: const { composer } = fromUseChat(useChat()); <Composer {...composer} />.
